question: Across the entire frozen Unicode-control corpus, does the actual v3 full-response grammar produce expected membership observations and reject every EOG at each prospectively selected natural incomplete-UTF8 token-prefix class?

language.duplicate_grammar_hashes: Retain four actual stage/payload instances; disclose duplicate hashes and the number of unique grammars.
language.authority: Authenticated packaged synthetic requests and registered questions only; structural bindings are not source/scientific admission.

corpus.scalar_basis: The fourteen exact scalar/encoding pairs in frozen UTF8-ORACLE-CORPUS-v2.json; no observed tokens or favorable boundary selection.

grid.type: chosen fourteen-by-three field/context pairing, not a full factorial

contexts.template: X + scalar repeated eight times + Y
e + U+0301 + A + scalar + U+1F600 + Z

grid.ASCII_counterpart_binding: Same stage and decoded full response as the raw claims[0].text case; different exact wire encoding is retained.

per_case_evidence: raw UTF8 or guard bytes as hex
raw nonASCII/width counts and ASCII escape counts
corpus.harness_null_reason: No native membership experiment is eligible for raw NUL or invalid UTF8; never substitute false membership.

piece_ledger.declared_harness_exception: The six native-byte-ineligible cases have ledger=null, retained exact harness reason and zero per-case document native calls. Their predefined population contribution is0 by declaration, not measured boundary absence.
piece_ledger.unexpected_QC_or_unknown: Ledger/counts remain null with reasons; never replace unknown with0.
piece_ledger.concatenation: Exactly the frozen raw document, byte for byte; every piece length <=B and their sum ==B.
piece_ledger.IDs: 0 <= token_id < observed vocabulary count; ordinary document token IDs must not be EOG.
piece_ledger.bound_violation: Explicit failed QC/incomplete profile; no allocation beyond cap, clipping, token dropping or partial ledger presented as complete.
piece_ledger.future_schema_obligation: Measure the exact fixed row overhead before bridge/runtime approval; the prospective arithmetic is not implementation conformance.

coverage.population: Predeclared expected-native-byte-eligible cases with generation expectation true and complete v3 semantic expectation true. Observed membership success is not a selection filter.
coverage.piece_interval: For nonempty piece j, [a,b) is reconstructed from all original piece lengths; 0<b<B.
coverage.pending_interval: A scalar interval [s,e) in the frozen strictUTF8 raw document satisfies s<b<e; its width is e-s.
coverage.mixed_condition: There exists a scalar interval [u,v) with a<=u<v<=s, wholly inside the same piece before the pending scalar. Completing an earlier-piece scalar alone does not qualify.
coverage.mixed_matrix_unit: Count a boundary once per DISTINCT wholly-contained complete-scalar width. Repeated samewidth scalars do not multiply. A multiwidth boundary can increment several cells, so matrixsum can exceed mixedboundarytotal.
coverage.selected_witnesses: Retain piece interval, pending scalar interval, allclasslabels and earliest contained scalar interval per distinct completewidth. Every boundary remains independently reconstructible from full piece arrays and frozen raw bytes.
counts: per-case and global candidate counts for every required class
coverage.expected_measured_counts_null_reason: No tokenizer, token vocabulary or native measurement is authorized or performed in source-only fixture design.

selector.order: Lexicographic (frozen case ordinal, original token ordinal)
selector.per_class: First qualifying natural boundary across the complete fixed population, after retaining every count/outcome.
selector.de_duplicate: Equal(case ordinal,token ordinal) sampled once; preserve all class-to-selection references.
selector.prefix: Original counted token prefix through the selected piece; never freshly tokenize the incomplete byte prefix.
selector.expected_prefix_observation: All ordinary prefix tokens admitted; every observed EOG rejected under the same original full response grammar.

coverage.required_availability: Every required count is known and >0; unavailable/unknown class makes the profile negative/incomplete.
coverage.case_mismatch: Retain it and fail the profile; never remove the case from availability analysis.
coverage.unknown_or_unsafe_case: Retain explicit failedQC/unknown status. Remaining unattempted cases/boundaries are unknown, not zero or biological absence.

JSONL_reservation.failure_policy: Fail explicitly when any exact schema/row/aggregate cap cannot be met; no silent omission.

prohibitions: No bridge/pack/runtime implementation before source/pure review and fixture freeze
No old profile edits, replacement or automatic rerun
